mapper.insert: INSERT INTO electronic_approval ( title, doc_type, approval_status, draft_dt, drafter_id, drafter_name, department_name ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{docType}, #{approvalStatus}, #{draftDate}, #{drafterId}, #{drafterName}, #{departmentName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_approval SET approval_status = 'COMPLETE', approve_dt = NOW() WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId}
mapper.select: SELECT approval_id AS approvalId, doc_type AS docType, doc_id AS docId, title AS title, approval_status AS approvalStatus, draft_dt AS draftDate, drafter_id AS drafterId, drafter_name AS drafterName, department_name AS departmentName, approve_dt AS approveDate FROM electronic_approval WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId}
